title: A red dot when WhatsApp needs attention, and a weekly voice-note test
text: The left menu now shows a red (problem) or amber (worth a look) exclamation mark next to WhatsApp, with a one-line description when you hover it. It lights up when the WhatsApp link is down, the nightly update needs attention, or the weekly voice-note test failed. Once a week the system also sends a short test voice note to one test phone and asks you in the WhatsApp page: Did it play? Yes or No. A No turns the page red and offers Send a new test.
points: Red or amber mark beside WhatsApp
Weekly voice-note test with Yes / No

steps.name: Open the WhatsApp page on Monday
steps.detail: A card asks if the test voice note played.

steps.name: Listen on the test phone
steps.detail: A short spoken test message arrives.

steps.name: Press Yes or No
steps.detail: A No turns the page red until you test again.
